steps.name: the account menu offered no "Switch Profile" entry. Either the menu did not open, or this account has no household (ONB-020). getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Switch Profile|Changer de profil/i })
Click getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Switch Profile|Changer de profil/i })

the switch dialog listed no child called "Alnf Child".
ROLE_PARENT_CHILD_NAME must match a profile that exists in this environment's household - the dialog shows the name the API returns, which for a child created by ONB-021 is "<first> <last>". getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button').filter({ hasText: 'Alnf Child' })

the profile switch was rejected (200). A 401 is usually a wrong ROLE_PARENT_CHILD_PIN - note the app locks a profile after 5 CONSECUTIVE failures (PAR-006), and the lockout outlives the run, though a correct PIN resets the counter. A 409 carrying P2002 on 'token' is the same-second refresh-token collision described above; seeing it here means it survived the one retry.
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: /Switch to Parent|Passer au profil parent/i })
Expect "toBeHidden" getByRole('button', { name: /Switch to Parent|Passer au profil parent/i })
